params.name: data_connection_id
params.description: Unique ID for the Data Connection. Can be found in the Datafold app under Settings > Integrations > Data Connections.

params.name: column_path
params.description: Path to the column, e.g. `db.schema.table.column`. The path is case sensitive. If components of the path contain periods, they must be quoted: `db.my_schema."www.mysite.com visits"."visit.id"`.

params.name: max_depth
params.description: Maximum depth of the lineage to retrieve.

params.name: include_tabular_nodes
params.description: Include Tables in the lineage calculation and in the output.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of columns or tables which depend on the given column.
